transcript.text: I need to raise a concern based on my notes from the spring pilot. The field sites can safely accommodate no more than 18 students, and every off-campus field activity requires two supervising adults. The draft proposal lists an enrollment cap of 28 and only one teacher for field activities, which conflicts with what we observed during the pilot. These notes are in the department folder but were not included in the draft proposal.
